target_customer: Professionals on back-to-back calls, mainly sales and client-facing roles, who pay per seat for meeting research and notes
problem: Admin work around meetings (pre-call research, notes, follow-ups, action items) eats time. Speck first tried to automate repetitive browser tasks and then pivoted to an AI notetaker.
business_model: Prosumer SaaS subscription (a directory lists pricing from $29 a month, unverified)

founders.name: Raghav Pillai
founders.background_notes: Built LLM tooling at Anduril and was an early engineer on Amazon Astro robotics, per the YC page.

founders.name: Lucas (surname not given on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Roblox engineer, founding engineer at Sweep, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Circleback
competitors.what: AI meeting notes and automations feeding Notion, Slack, HubSpot and Salesforce
competitors.traction_then: Launched via Launch HN in the same YC W24 batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Meeting transcription and LLM summarization were available through third-party APIs in 2024, so a team of two or three could ship quickly. The earlier browser recorder with self-repairing automations was harder.

defensibility.rationale: Many notetakers existed and big vendors bundled notes into their meeting tools, so features were copyable in weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms shipped native AI notes through 2024 and 2025. Speck was acquired in 2025 by a buyer that is not named publicly.

market_need_then: Meeting overload and heavy demand for AI notetakers in 2024, shown by many funded entrants such as Circleback and Fathom. Speck's own pivot two weeks before launch suggests the first idea lacked pull.

branding.domain_note: Uses speck.sh rather than an exact .com

identity.logo: Square mark on a sky background image
identity.visual_style: Minimal landing page with a YC backed badge
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led, for example world-class meeting research before every call

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, mascot or community found. Name is generic and shared with other software such as Speckle.

pivots.from: Browser extension that records and automates repetitive web tasks
pivots.why: The YC launch post says the team pivoted about two weeks before launching its beta. Reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Speck pivoted from browser automation to an AI notetaker in a crowded and fast commoditizing category with a team of three. The site banner says it was acquired in 2025, but no acquirer, price or date is public, and no priced funding round was found, so the exit looks like a small soft landing rather than a proven product win.
notes: Trackers (VCBacked, Crunchbase) list a $500K pre-seed dated 2023-10 with Y Combinator as investor; this is aggregator only and unverified, so not recorded as a round. Acquisition shown only by a site banner and YC and directory status. A second YC page variant showed status Active. A second source gives Lucas the surname Jaggernauth, but that page looked auto generated, so it is not used. Competition list is limited to one dated item. Completeness pass: The 500K pre-seed rests on two trackers (VCBacked, BounceWatch), no press.
